limitations: L4 is offline synthetic fixture acceptance only; no culture, assay, biological, product or clinical validity is established.
Poisson counts and binomial sampling with known exposures are assumptions. Countability and clumping selection may affect coverage.
Hashes do not establish historical freeze timing or true source independence. The pack always leaves independent review unavailable.

Conservative case-insensitive English whole-word/prefix families: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Also culture health, releas*, health*, truth, physical validity, patient benefit, steril*, safe* and poten*. The gate includes negations and is incomplete.
Unavailable evidence requires unavailable claims. Computed agreement and review approval never support positive claims; one synthetic fixture never establishes replication.
Read-only input limits are 64 MiB each, 256 MiB aggregate, 256 paths and 4000000 JSON values; hardlink aliases share initial reads and parsing.
